component.subject: Eucharist
component.title: The Fencing of the Table
component.source: 1 Corinthians 11:27-28, Psalm 139:23-24 and 1 John 1:9 (World English Bible), verbatim. Every spoken word is scripture.

original.p: 1 Corinthians 11:27-28 (WEB): Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord. But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
Psalm 139:23-24 (WEB): Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
1 John 1:9 (WEB): If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

block.p: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord. But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
